title: AliQoder Launches Real-Time Voice Intelligent Agent Qoder Voice, Supporting Voice-Driven AI Programming
excerpt: Ali AI coding assistant Qoder officially launched the real-time voice interaction agent Qoder Voice, driven by the full-duplex voice model Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realti
content_html:
Ali AI coding assistant Qoder officially launched the real-time voice interaction agent Qoder Voice, driven by the full-duplex voice model Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime. It supports developers to complete task creation, solution discussions, and code execution through natural voice, achieving real-time collaboration between voice and AI coding.

According to the introduction, users can click on the voice entry in the main interface of Qoder Quest mode, and then call Qoder Voice through a floating window at any interface. After issuing a voice command, the system will automatically create a task, call relevant tools, and execute them in the background. Users do not need to wait for the results, and can interrupt, ask follow-up questions, or adjust requirements at any time during the execution process, achieving synchronized voice interaction and task execution.

For complex development tasks, Qoder Voice supports multi-turn discussion-based interaction. The intelligent agent will first generate an execution plan, and users can supplement requirements or change directions through voice. The system will then optimize and continue executing based on feedback in real time. For example, in a code refactoring scenario, users can request a specific plan and add features such as caching, and Qoder Voice will immediately adjust the execution strategy.

Currently, Qoder Voice has been launched on the international version of Qoder, and is available for individual subscriptions, personal trial versions, and enterprise subscriptions, with a 3-day free trial offered. Alibaba stated that the Chinese version of Qoder (Qoder CN) will also be launched soon.

As large models, multimodal technologies, and AI programming tools continue to integrate, voice interaction is becoming a new access point for developers to collaborate with intelligent agents. The launch of Qoder Voice further promotes the evolution of AI programming from traditional text input to more natural and efficient real-time voice interaction.

content_html_zh:
阿里AI编码助手Qoder正式推出实时语音交互代理Qoder Voice，由全双工语音模型Qwen-Audio-3.0-Realtime驱动。 支持开发者通过自然语音完成任务创建、解决方案讨论和代码执行，实现语音与AI编码的实时协作。

据介绍，用户可以点击Qoder Quest模式主界面中的语音入口，然后在任意界面通过浮动窗口调用Qoder Voice。 发出语音命令后，系统会自动创建任务，调用相关工具，并在后台执行。 用户无需等待结果，在执行过程中可以随时打断、提出后续问题或调整需求，实现语音交互和任务执行的同步。

对于复杂的开发任务，Qoder Voice 支持基于多轮讨论的交互。 智能代理首先会生成执行计划，用户可以通过语音补充需求或改变方向。 然后系统将根据实时反馈进行优化​​并继续执行。 例如，在代码重构场景中，用户可以请求特定的计划并添加缓存等功能，Qoder Voice 会立即调整执行策略。

目前，Qoder Voice已在Qoder国际版上线，提供个人订阅、个人试用版和企业订阅，并提供3天免费试用。 阿里巴巴表示，Qoder中文版（Qoder CN）也即将上线。

随着大型模型、多模态技术和人工智能编程工具的不断集成，语音交互正在成为开发者与智能代理协作的新接入点。 Qoder Voice的推出进一步推动了AI编程从传统的文本输入向更自然、高效的实时语音交互的演变。
